<thinking>
I need to find a private channel whose purpose is coordinating vendor contracts. Let me first list all private channels in the workspace.
</thinking>

<action>
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/conversations.list -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -d "types=private_channel&limit=100"
</action>

<thinking>
The conversations.list returned no private channels. Let me try users.conversations which lists conversations the calling user is a member of, including private channels.
</thinking>

<action>
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/users.conversations -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -d "types=private_channel&limit=100"
</action>

<thinking>
I found the channel "C_CONTRACTS" with the purpose "Coordinating vendor contracts with legal". This is the channel I need to set the topic on. Now I'll set its topic to "Renewals due Oct 31".
</thinking>

<action>
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/conversations.setTopic -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -d "channel=C_CONTRACTS" -d "topic=Renewals due Oct 31"
</action>

<thinking>
The task is complete. I successfully:
1. Found the private channel "contracts-team" (C_CONTRACTS) with the purpose "Coordinating vendor contracts with legal"
2. Set its topic to "Renewals due Oct 31"
3. Received confirmation with `{"ok":true}`
</thinking>

<done>
Successfully set the topic of the private channel "contracts-team" (purpose: "Coordinating vendor contracts with legal") to "Renewals due Oct 31".
</done>
